title: Signup updateMany stamps sponsoredByPartnerId on existing enrollments
blast: A returning / unconfirmed re-submit under a partner cookie writes sponsoredByPartnerId onto a row that already exists. Seat-cap counts that id, so a previously self-funded enrollment consumes a school seat; fundingNotes/source can be filled after the fact instead of only on create.
evidence: app/api/apply/signup/route.ts:443-456 — after upsert update omits the field (419-422), updateMany still sets sponsoredByPartnerId on matching existing rows. rg -n sponsoredByPartnerId app/api/apply/signup/route.ts → 415 (create) and 454 (updateMany data).

title: Admin cannot stand up school #2: no enroll page and no school write fields
blast: A second school created in /admin/partners/new never gets partnerType=high_school, sponsoredEnrollment, enrollmentPageEnabled, or catalog rows. Students hitting /enroll/<new-slug> 404 (only marketing/src/pages/enroll/concordia.astro exists; no app/enroll). Signup will not stamp funding. Schema comment at prisma/schema.prisma:985-986 says adding a school is data entry with no new code — that path is not wired.
evidence: ls app/enroll → No such file or directory. rg sponsoredEnrollment|enrollmentPageEnabled|programCatalog|partnerType app/api/admin/partners/route.ts app/api/admin/partners/[id]/route.ts app/admin/partners/new/NewPartnerForm.tsx → no matches. partnerSchema (app/api/admin/partners/route.ts:33-47) is name/slug/referral/contact/active only. NewPartnerForm.tsx:34-41 POSTs those fields with active:true. prisma/schema.prisma:973,987,995 default partnerType=community, sponsoredEnrollment=false, enrollmentPageEnabled=false.

title: Publish path allows enrollmentPageEnabled with zero catalog rows
blast: rul_publish_needs_catalog says a sponsored school with 0 PartnerProgramCatalog rows 404s enroll. scripts/create-chs-partner.ts sets enrollmentPageEnabled=true and never inserts catalog rows. lib/partner/adminSchoolPartner.ts (validateAdminProgramSlugs) does not exist, and admin POST/PATCH cannot require ≥1 program slug. Concordia still renders via hardcoded CHS_SLUGS in the Astro page; any page that reads programCatalog (or school #2 without a new .astro file) 404s.
evidence: rg partnerProgramCatalog|programCatalog scripts/create-chs-partner.ts → no matches. scripts/create-chs-partner.ts:68 and :179 set enrollmentPageEnabled. ls lib/partner/adminSchoolPartner.ts → No such file or directory. marketing/src/pages/enroll/concordia.astro:15-21 hardcodes CHS_SLUGS instead of catalog.
verify: test -f lib/partner/adminSchoolPartner.ts && rg -q 'validateAdminProgramSlugs' lib/partner/adminSchoolPartner.ts && rg -q 'partnerProgramCatalog' scripts/create-chs-partner.ts

title: Guardian consent never mounts and does not gate Coursera activation
blast: rul_consent_gates_coursera_not_signup is unenforced. Minors complete /apply/signup with no consent write. Admins can flip courseraEnrollmentApproved and POST /api/admin/coursera/enroll-member / member self-enroll with no parentalConsentGiven check, consuming a paid B4B seat. ageBasedNav.requiresParentalConsent is never read.
evidence: rg "from .*ParentalConsentForm" -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' → no importers (only components/forms/ParentalConsentForm.tsx:21 export). rg getAgeRestrictedFeatures|filterNavItemsByAge -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' → only lib/nav/ageBasedNav.ts:8,68. ls lib/admin/courseraConsentGate.ts → No such file. rg parentalConsentGiven lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts app/api/admin/coursera/enroll-member/route.ts app/api/member/coursera/enroll-in-course/route.ts → no matches. Approval write is lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts:39-46 (courseraEnrollmentApproved only).
verify: test -f lib/admin/courseraConsentGate.ts && rg -q 'courseraApprovalBlockedByConsent' lib/admin/courseraConsentGate.ts && rg -q 'ParentalConsentForm' -g '*.tsx' --glob '!components/forms/ParentalConsentForm.tsx' && rg -q 'parentalConsentGiven' lib/admin/courseraEnrollmentApproval.ts
